exposure: preference for mode of birth (cesarean vs. normal birth)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 160 nulliparous female health personnel working in the delivery room of Basaksehir Cam and Sakura City Hospital Gynecology Clinic.
finding: Nulliparous female health personnel experience birth anxiety, with factors such as age, witnessing complicated births, and preferred mode of birth contributing to its development.
mod_finding: Participants preferring cesarean delivery exhibited higher birth anxiety scores compared to those preferring normal birth.
